goal: Produce an exact-binding research foundation for a Whisper writing substrate that makes the CyberAlchemy portfolio easier to understand as a family of human-augmenting cognitive tools. Preserve the distinct truth, status, voice, retained human judgment, and claim ceiling of all fourteen entries without treating every project as a finished product or authorizing public copy, HTML mutation, or deployment.
context: The deployed cyberalchemize.com portfolio currently matches projects/co-op-engine/index.html and already provides craft filters plus progressive project detail, but it does not yet explain a coherent product worldview. Earlier auditor-approved Co-Op research contains fourteen source-bounded project cards and rejects unsupported labels such as generic AI collaborator, agentic writer studio, and knowledge graph, while the live page still carries some of that wording. This dispatch researches only the delta: a task-first augmentation model, an ergonomic content grammar, and a public-safe claim map that can later feed Whisper without moving canonical method, product-truth, or publication authority.
anti_bias_global: Source-grounded product differentiation versus simplified human-purpose unification, challenged through complementary corpora, methods, and attack vectors.

groups.anti_bias: Composite source-corpus and methodology axis: repository truth mapping, task-based cognitive ergonomics, and systems-level human-machine framing.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 verifies repository truth and project-specific claim ceilings while agent 1 tests task-first navigation and comprehension structures on the source-corpus and methodology axes; a bias in agent 0 toward a faithful but inert catalog would be exposed by agent 1, while a bias in agent 1 toward a simpler interface that erases project distinctions would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 0 derives only source-bound product distinctions while agent 2 derives a systems-level human-machine augmentation frame from public method sources, private candidate philosophy, and primary external precedent on the source-corpus and methodology axes; a bias in agent 0 toward disconnected project facts would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward one attractive worldview that outruns project evidence or public authority would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 evaluates scanability, progressive disclosure, retellability, and reader decisions while agent 2 evaluates retained agency, evidence, reversibility, and human-machine control loops on the source-corpus and methodology axes; a bias in agent 1 toward measurable navigation without meaningful philosophy would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward conceptually rich but cognitively expensive language would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: Repository-truth mapper: verify the fourteen current portfolio entries, their distinct product or project posture, source selectors, status, retained human judgment, forbidden claims, and unresolved owners.

Build the exact product-truth foundation for a CyberAlchemy product-cognition writing substrate. Inspect the deployed/local projects/co-op-engine/index.html, the auditor-approved 2026-07-25 Co-Op portfolio findings and direct sources behind all fourteen project cards, the later showcase/frontend strategy evidence where current, the CyberAlchemy website page contract and Whisper preset, and the strategy Inventory packet. Inventory is discovery only: independently verify every load-bearing current-source claim. Produce: (1) one exact-binding row for each of the fourteen entries with current display name, canonical or candidate owner, human job, concrete mechanism, retained human judgment, what exists, evidence/status, limit, forbidden wording, next bounded move, public/private boundary, and exact source selectors; (2) discrepancies between live copy and accepted source ceilings; (3) which entries may be described as products, prototypes, research systems, methods, or concepts without inflation; (4) project-voice terms that must survive any shared grammar; (5) gaps requiring owner admission; and (6) a concise recommendation for what one shared product card may and may not normalize. Use immutable repository source identity and exact selectors or structured pointers. Do not edit files, browse unrelated private material, authorize public wording, relabel all entries as products, or infer maturity from polish. Return a structured exact-binding receipt plus concise narrative. Output target about 4400 tokens.

groups.anti_bias: Attack-vector axis: precedent and owner duplication, non-vacuity through complete fourteen-entry recomposition, and definitional plus public-authority non-collapse.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs a precedent and owner-duplication attack while agent 1 runs a non-vacuity attack through a finite fourteen-entry recomposition witness on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward reusing an owned but ergonomically inert structure would be exposed by agent 1, while a bias in agent 1 toward a persuasive bespoke taxonomy that duplicates an existing owner would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 0 classifies existing product, method, portfolio, writing, and interface owners while agent 2 attacks definitional and public-authority collapse on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward reusing source language under the wrong public meaning would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward rejecting compatible reuse merely because wording differs would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 requires every proposed lens and card field to change a reader decision across all fourteen entries while agent 2 requires augmentation, product, project, evidence, status, judgment, and authority to remain distinct on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 1 toward a concrete but conceptually inflated view would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward precise distinctions that no reader can use would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: Precedent gate: determine whether current portfolio, earlier Co-Op findings, Whisper, public method sources, or external information-architecture patterns already own each proposed structure or phrase.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only precedent, ownership, and duplication in the synthesized product-cognition substrate. Verify current direct repository sources and the explorers' primary external sources rather than Inventory summaries. For every proposed lens, card field, explanation sequence, public claim, validation check, and Whisper handoff field, identify the current owner and classify already-deployed, build-from-owned, proposal-only, owner-conflict, or precedent-clean only after an actual bounded search. Treat prior Co-Op research and the current live page as possible owners, not automatic answers. Being owned is never itself a KILL. Require an explicit public/private disposition and separate product truth, method authority, writing authority, interface ownership, and publication. Return PASS or exact repairs with source identities, selectors, and owner consequences. Do not edit files. Output target about 2800 tokens.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity gate: force the proposed worldview and content grammar through all fourteen entries, two audience profiles, current copy discrepancies, and discriminating retellability failures.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only non-vacuity. Require a finite witness that maps all fourteen current portfolio entries through the proposed task or augmentation lenses and the shared content grammar without orphaning an entry, duplicating one as two products, hiding status, erasing project voice, or implying a stronger claim. Require at least one technical-builder and one domain-practitioner reading path, plus known-good, known-bad, and false-positive retellability fixtures. For every field name the reader decision it changes, the exact supporting source, and the failure if absent. KILL a lens, field, or phrase that does not change a decision or cannot produce a counterexample. Browser mechanics, schema completeness, and prose polish may not stand in for comprehension or product validity. Return PASS or exact repairs and the minimum surviving witness. Do not edit files. Output target about 3200 tokens.

agents.angle: Definitional and authority gate: prevent cognitive augmentation, product status, human judgment, evidence, project identity, and public claim authority from collapsing into generic AI language.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only definitional soundness and authority non-collapse. Test every retained noun and relation against at least these distinctions: project versus product; method versus tool; working artifact versus research or concept; human objective versus machine capability; recommendation versus execution; memory versus authority; evidence versus approval; retained judgment versus automated choice; cognitive support versus cognition measurement; source truth versus audience projection; public method source versus private candidate philosophy; draft substrate versus approved public copy; browser reachability versus comprehension, recruitment, deployment, or production. Return KEEP, MERGE, RENAME, DEFER, or KILL and PASS only if the repaired vocabulary remains useful to cold readers. Do not edit files. Output target about 3200 tokens.
